subject: StellarNet trial — scheduling demo and IT gating
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New inbound trial — StellarNet (self-serve sign up)

Hi Grace / Ben —

Heads-up: StellarNet just converted from the self-serve trial and requested a walkthrough/demo. Lead contact is Caroline Thomas (caroline.thomas@stellarnet.com). They noted interest in the low-latency streaming use case and asked for an IT/security attendee to validate network/retention implications.

Key lead details (from signup):
- Company: StellarNet (US, finance infra)
- Contact: Caroline Thomas, Director of Product
- Trial plan: 14-day eval (token budget attached in HubSpot)

As discussed in SDR playbook, can we land a 45-min live demo next week with SE + AE + IT? I flagged this as high priority because they mentioned SOC/compliance gating. I attached the signup export and the customer's brief security checklist they uploaded.

Attachments: [StellarNet_signup_export.csv], [StellarNet_Security_Checklist.pdf] (forwarded by lead)

Next step: suggest 3 slots and I can send an intro "calendar invite with options". Grace — can you propose times in the thread? Thanks!

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | SDR, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New inbound trial — StellarNet (self-serve sign up) — demo options

Hi Caroline —

Welcome and thanks for signing up — excited to get StellarNet onboarded. I'm the AE assigned and Ben (cc) will cover the technical walkthrough. Would love to schedule a 45-minute demo next week that includes your IT/security lead so we can review any network or data controls up front.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue 9/14 — 10:00–10:45am PT (1:00–1:45pm ET)
- Tue 9/14 — 3:00–3:45pm PT (6:00–6:45pm ET)
- Wed 9/15 — 8:30–9:15am PT (11:30–12:15pm ET)

If none of these work, tell me two windows that do and we'll iterate. Also please loop in your IT/security contact (or cc itops@stellarnet.com) — Ben and I typically do a short prep with IT if they have questions about network egress, firewall rules, or audit logs.

Draft agenda (attached): 1) Brief intro & goals (5) 2) Platform tour + live example (25) 3) IT/security Q&A (10) 4) Next steps (5)

Attachments: [proposed-demo-agenda.docx]

Thanks and speak soon —
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the quick reply and the proposed agenda. We're on Eastern Time; the Tue 9/14 1:00–1:45pm ET slot (your first option) would work best for us. I'll plan to include Michael Reed (our infrastructure lead) and the itops alias.

A couple of asks from my side in advance:
- Can you confirm whether the demo will show an example dataset and whether token retention is configurable?
- We'd like a quick checklist of network ports/outbound hosts your runtime needs so our infra team can pre-authorize them.

I've attached the StellarNet internal security checklist that we use for vendor onboarding — hopefully this helps your team prepare.

Thanks,
Caroline Thomas

caroline.thomas@stellarnet.com | +1 617-555-0784

Subject: Re: New inbound trial — StellarNet (self-serve sign up) — demo options

Hi Caroline / Grace —

Thanks — confirmed for Tue 9/14 at 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET. I'll lead the demo portion. A couple quick notes from SE side:

- We will use a short example dataset (sanitized) during the demo; token retention is configurable per-tenant and we can show the retention settings in Console.
- For network prep: we typically need outbound HTTPS to the Redwood runtime endpoints and (optionally) port 443 to model serving endpoints. If you have an egress proxy, please allow our runtime hostnames (I included a short stub below).

Could Michael or your IT alias join a 15-minute pre-call 30 minutes before the demo to review the network checklist? That avoids delays during the demo. I can do 9:30am PT / 12:30pm ET.

Stub: outbound hosts — runtime.redwood.ai, api.redwood.ai; ports — 443. (I'll follow up with a one-pager for your security team.)

— Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0168
